findings.detail: Identifier maturity text was populated from a non-matching date while the row-level SOI maturity is available and matches the structured value.

rationale: This is Class 2 within-row localization. The raw SOI schedule rows decide the issue: for matched issuer/instrument/coupon rows, the Maturity column contains the structured residual date rather than the maturity embedded in the generated identifier text. Examples include Orion at 10/10/2032 rather than identifier 5/19/2032, Higginbotham delayed draw rows at 9/30/2026 and 12/10/2027 rather than identifier 6/11/2031, Cherry Bekaert 8.22% rows at 6/28/2030 rather than identifier 6/30/2030, Applied Systems 6.17% row at 2/24/2031 rather than identifier 9/19/2026, and Madison IAQ 6.64% row at 11/8/2032 rather than identifier 11/5/2032. The check is therefore catching a real generated identifier maturity defect, not a false alarm.
